class.name: HTMLFormElement
class.brief_description: An HTML form with ordered form data.
class.description: Use [method get_controls] to inspect associations and [method HTMLLabel.submit_form] to validate and submit through Godot signals.

method.name: get_controls
method.description: Returns a tree-order snapshot of the associated controls.

method.name: get_form_data
method.description: Returns ordered dictionaries with [code]name[/code] and [code]value[/code] keys. Repeated names remain separate. File entries hold [HTMLInputFile] values. The optional submitter must be enabled and associated with this form. An image submitter produces two coordinate entries whose values default to [code]0[/code].

method.name: reset
method.description: Restores all associated controls to their markup defaults, clears edit state, and schedules one layout update when connected.
